definitions.gloss: shadow picture; shadow play; silhouette show
definitions.explanation: Pictures made by casting the shadows of hands, cut-out figures or puppets onto a screen or wall, and the shows performed this way.

examples.english: To make shadow pictures with your hands.
A shadow-picture dog appeared on the wall.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧{影絵|かげえ}⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧になっていた。
examples.english: The children were absorbed in the shadow play cast onto the paper screen.
